subject.title: [Feature]: Keep Codex app-server with Gateway for remote execution

question: Should OpenClaw add an experimental Codex plugin config for local stdio app-server plus authenticated remote exec-server environments, or defer this topology until the upstream Codex remote-environment contract is more stable?
rationale: The issue crosses remote code execution, credentials, config compatibility, thread-state identity, and upstream experimental APIs, so automation cannot choose the security boundary or support policy safely.

options.title: Approve experimental plugin-owned implementation
options.body: Implement the feature in the bundled Codex plugin behind explicit experimental config with SecretRefs, fail-closed unsupported combinations, environment-aware fingerprints, and live remote-exec proof.

options.title: Defer until upstream stabilizes
options.body: Keep the issue open as design backlog and avoid adding OpenClaw config until Codex remote execution environments graduate from experimental contract status.

options.title: Reject core/runtime support
options.body: Close the request after documenting that production remote workspaces must use an external topology or plugin outside OpenClaw core until a missing API is proven.

recommendation.title: Approve experimental plugin-owned implementation
recommendation.body: Implement the feature in the bundled Codex plugin behind explicit experimental config with SecretRefs, fail-closed unsupported combinations, environment-aware fingerprints, and live remote-exec proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the current issue and recent Codex app-server/runtime-binding history most directly connected to the decision.
